text:
maria: Heads-up: Brookline sent a LoRA for nightjar-13b. They want int4 bring-up today + a quick tokenization/amounts check.
ashok: Got the file `brookline_invoice_v1.lora`. Any special token additions?
taylor: They added `<invoice>` and `<amt>`. I dry-merged and saw numeric token splits on a few samples.
maria: Example: input `Total: $1,200.00` -> base model gives `Total: $1200.00` but merged model emits `Total: $1 , 200 . 00`.
samir: Likely token id collision or tokenizer merges differ. @ashok can you export tokenizer metadata?
ashok: quick dump: {"tokenizer_version":"v2.3.1","added_tokens":["<invoice>","<amt>"],"normalization":"nfkc"} (pasted raw)
dev-bot: run summary: [WARN] sample 42 token boundary mismatch; [ERROR] sample 87 decode divergence >0.12 on int4 quant smoke
ashok: Quant smoke command I ran: `run_quant --model nightjar-13b --lora brookline_invoice_v1.lora --bits 4 --samples 200` — failures cluster around currency and parentheses.
taylor: For quick eval pack propose: 150 invoices (multi-locale), 50 edge-cases (parentheses, ranges, currency combos), 30 long-thread invoices. Include the canonical JSON reformat check (amount -> number).
qa-bot: Scheduling quickpack on nightjar-13b-int4-shadow at 16:15 UTC.
samir: Also run token-map diff: `python tools/token_map.py base_tok.json merged_tok.json > tok-diff.txt`. If there's an id collision, reassign added tokens to high id space.
ashok: token-map diff shows `<amt>` mapped to 50234 which collides with merged punctuation clusters. Suggest reassign start-id 100000.
taylor: Patch quick command: `python tools/reassign_tokens.py merged_tok.json --start-id 100000 && python tools/build_merges.py --tok merged_tok.json --out merges.json`
maria: Plan: 1) quickpack run 2) token-map diff + remap if collision 3) re-run quant smoke 4) surface top 10 regressions + examples to Brookline.
ashok: quickpack id run_20240318_qp_87; quant id run_20240318_qs_21. Posting partial: quickpack 150/150 finished, 8 flagged regressions. Example: IN: "Total: $1,200.00" | BASE: "Total: $1200.00" | MERGED: "Total: $1 , 200 . 00"
ashok: quant smoke partial 100/200, 3 divergence errors concentrated on currency spacing.
taylor: small correction to my name :)
maria: After remap, if green push canary to dedicated pool and share results. :thumbsup:
qa-bot: quickpack complete. Artifacts: s3://redwood-shadow/nightjar/brookline/qp_87/{report.csv,tok-diff.txt,examples.zip}
samir: If quickpack tokenization regressions >3% I'll reassign tokens and trigger rebuild.
ashok: starting remap patch now and will re-run quant smoke. Will post diffs and before/after snippets.
taylor: I'll prep the templated report with token-level diff columns and `before/after` snippets.
maria: Great. Sync in 30 for remediation decision.
ashok: noted, running `python tools/reassign_tokens.py merged_tok.json --start-id 100000` now.
